google.demoDialogBody: Ba a saita shigarwar Google a cikin wannan ginin ba, don haka wannan kwaikwayo ne kawai. Babu asusun Google da aka yi amfani da shi kuma babu abin da aka aika zuwa Google.
google.setupIntro: Don shiga tare da ainihin asusun Google kana buƙatar ID na abokin ciniki na OAuth. Samar da ɗaya yana ɗaukar minutesan mintuna kuma yana buƙatar asusun Google.
google.step1: A cikin Google Cloud console bude APIs & Services, sa'an nan kuma takardun shaida, da kuma haifar da wani OAuth abokin ciniki ID na irin Web aikace-aikace.
google.step2: A karkashin Authorized JavaScript asali ƙara {{origin}}. Lokacin gwaji a kan localhost, kuma ƙara http://localhost.
google.step3: Ka saka ID na abokin ciniki a ƙasa. Yana da wani jama'a ganewa, ba wani asiri. Kada ka manna wani abokin ciniki asiri.
google.clientId: ID na abokin ciniki na Google
google.saved: An adana ID na abokin ciniki na Google. Maɓallin Google na ainihi yanzu yana aiki.
google.removed: An cire ID na abokin ciniki na Google.
google.fromBuild: An gina wannan shafin tare da ID na abokin ciniki na Google.
google.errorFormat: Wannan ba ID na abokin ciniki na Google bane. ID na abokin ciniki ya ƙare da .apps.googleusercontent.com.
google.errorSecret: Wannan ya zama kamar asirin abokin ciniki. Kada ka saka asirin a nan. Yi amfani da ID na abokin ciniki a maimakon haka.

inbox.title: Demo akwatin saƙo mai shiga
inbox.description: Wannan gina ba shi da mail uwar garken ko SMS gateway, don haka saƙonnin da ChainBeat sends bayyana a nan maimakon. Babu abin da ya bar browser.

inbox.resetSubject: Sake saita kalmar sirri ta ChainBeat
inbox.resetBody: Yi amfani da wannan lambar don zaɓar sabon kalmar sirri. Idan ba ka nemi wannan ba, za ka iya watsi da wannan saƙon.
inbox.recoverSubject: Neman sunan mai amfani na ChainBeat
inbox.recoverBody: Ka yi amfani da wannan lambar don tabbatar da kai ne kuma ka ga sunan mai amfani.
inbox.noAccountBody: Mun karɓi buƙata don wannan adireshin, amma babu wani asusun ChainBeat da ke amfani da shi. Idan kai ne, zaka iya ƙirƙirar asusu. Idan ba haka ba, zaka iya watsi da wannan sakon.
